newsitem.title: USA:NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-GREEN BAY RUNNING BACK EDGAR BENNETT HAS SURGERY.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-GREEN BAY RUNNING BACK EDGAR BENNETT HAS SURGERY.

text.p: Edgar Bennett, star running back for the Super Bowl champion Green Bay Packers, had surgery Tuesday to repair a torn left Achilles tendon.
Bennett suffered the season-ending injury in the first quarter of Saturday's preseason opener against Miami.
The surgery was performed at a local hospital by Packers team physician Dr Patrick McKenzie. Bennett will be in a cast for three to six weeks and will likely need six months to recover.
"It's hard to say how long it will take, but the doctors say about six months," said Packers coach Mike Holmgren.

Bennett was a key contributor to Green Bay's march to the National Football League championship last season. He rushed for 899 yards on 222 carries with a pair of touchdowns, adding 176 yards on 31 catches, including one for a score.
In the three playoff wins, Bennett led the team with 179 rushing yards on 42 attempts and scored three times for a team-best 18 points. He also caught four passes for 19 yards.

Over the last two seasons, only five other running backs in the NFC have run for more yards that Bennett's 1,996. He has caught passes in 60 straight games, and is Green Bay's all-time leading playoff rusher with 521 yards.
